title: From The Calcium
body:
This mod is entirely based on a one off comment made by Dejojotheawsome at 2:44 in his video [Destroying From the Caves to Prove a Point](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2MBe3fbwy-k). This horror mod is 100x scarier than From the Caves (guaranteed) bc it when it do the skeleton when you when the the skeleton um when it spawn its a lot
All skeleton spawns are boosted 20 times, and they can call for reinforcements like zombies. requires fabric api More features hopfully to come
